meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: 安装此技能后,Claude可以按照WCAG 2.2标准对网站进行无障碍审计,结合自动测试与手动验证,并给出修复指导,帮助你修复违规问题、实现无障碍设计模式。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计网站无障碍、修复WCAG违规,或实现无障碍设计模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个网站是否符合WCAG 2.2
say.note: Claude会进行自动和手动检查并给出修复建议。

say.text: 检查一下这段代码有没有无障碍问题
say.note: Claude会对照WCAG标准分析并指出违规。

say.text: 如何修复这个颜色对比度不足的问题?
say.note: Claude会给出具体的修复指导。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude can conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits, combining automated testing and manual verification, and provide remediation guidance to fix violations and implement accessible patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask to audit websites for accessibility, fix WCAG violations, or implement accessible design patterns.

say_en.text: Audit this website for WCAG 2.2 compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will run automated and manual checks and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Check this code for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze against WCAG standards and point out violations.

say_en.text: How do I fix this color contrast problem?
say_en.note: Claude will provide specific remediation steps.
